alternatives.quote: To this end, we present a novel joint training approach for dense passage retrieval and passage re-ranking (called RocketQAv2). alternatives.title: Dense Passage Retrieval for Open-Domain Question Answering
alternatives.quote: We consider three different types of negatives: (1) Random: any random passage from the corpus; (2) BM25: top passages returned by BM25 which don’t contain the answer but match most question tokens; (3) Gold: positive passages paired with other questions which appear in the training set. alternatives.title: RocketQAv2: A Joint Training Method for Dense Passage Retrieval and Passage Re-ranking
alternatives.quote: To this end, we present a novel joint training approach for dense passage retrieval and passage re-ranking (called RocketQAv2). The major con- tribution of our approach is the novel dynamic list- wise distillation mechanism for jointly training the retriever and the re-ranker. Based on a uniﬁed listwise training approach, we can readily transfer relevance information between the two modules. Unlike previous distillation methods that usually froze one module, our approach enables the two modules to adaptively learn relevance information from each other, which is the key to mutual im- provement in joint training.
